name: Dark Ceremony
summary: After the Gordunni Scroll, Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache reads it as plans for a dark ceremony led by the Gordunni mage-lords. Rok Orhan wants you to take an orb from one of those mage-lords, to learn more about the ceremony and the Gordunni's magic.

sections.title: Plans for a Dark Ceremony
sections.body: Rok Orhan has looked over the Gordunni Scroll you brought and reads it as the plans for a dark ceremony. As far as Rok can tell, the Gordunni mage-lords are the ones who conduct it. A mage-lord must be found, and an orb taken from him. A mage's orb holds great power, and it should reveal more about the ceremony and the magic the Gordunni wield.

sections.title: When the Orb Is Delivered
sections.body: Once the orb is in hand, Rok Orhan says it will tell more about the Gordunni, and the knowledge will go into planning their downfall.

faq.answer: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache, following the Gordunni Scroll you brought.

faq.q: Who carries out the dark ceremony?
aliases: who is performing the dark ceremony
faq.answer: Rok Orhan makes out from the plans that the Gordunni mage-lords conduct it.

faq.q: What orb is Rok Orhan after?
faq.answer: An orb taken from one of the Gordunni mage-lords. The orb of a mage holds great power, and Rok Orhan expects it to teach more about the ceremony and the Gordunni's magic.
The chain goes on with The Gordunni Orb.
